answer: Operator registers a node, posting a 40-token bond and its unique key. Every 24 hours, a random peer verifies the key is active; failure triggers immediate slashing. The fable of cheap clones dies here: timber costs 40 to build, but each seat pays only 3 in rewards. If you spawn five hollow twins, you lose 37 tokens per clone after fees. At epoch close, peers check receipts. Missing one receipt slashes 10 tokens automatically. The mechanism is simple: bond high, verify daily, and let the math burn the sybil. No trust, just ledger entries.
